description: List open appointment times for a mobile dog wash. Returns a map of date (YYYY-MM-DD) to UTC ISO start times. Present times to the user in Pacific Time (America/Los_Angeles). Defaults to the next 14 days.

end_date.description: Last day to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to start_date + 14 days.

start_date.description: First day to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: get_available_slots
